en_title: Everything Announced at the Marvel Studios SDCC Panel | Comic Con 2026
subtitle: 毁灭之日见

paragraphs.en: Marvel Studios' San Diego Comic-Con 2026 presentation is over, and we've got everything announced right here.
paragraphs.cn: 漫威影业在2026年圣地亚哥国际动漫展的发布会已经结束，所有公布内容都汇总在这里。

paragraphs.en: The headline reveals include a new Ghost Rider movie starring Ryan Gosling in the title role, confirmation that Deadpool and Peggy Carter are in Avengers: Doomsday , and Black Panther 3 coming in 2028 ! We did not get any Avengers: Secret Wars information, nor any X-Men movie details.
paragraphs.cn: 重点公布内容包括：瑞恩·高斯林将主演全新《恶灵骑士》电影；死侍和佩吉·卡特确认会登场《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》；《黑豹3》则定于2028年推出。不过，本次没有公布任何《复仇者联盟：秘密战争》或《X战警》电影的消息。

paragraphs.en: For more, check out our live updates direct from Hall H below. And if you're wondering what this means for the future of the Marvel Cinematic Universe, check out our slideshow on every upcoming movie and TV show in the MCU.
paragraphs.cn: 更多内容请见下方来自H厅的实时更新。如果你想知道这对漫威电影宇宙的未来意味着什么，也可以查看我们整理的MCU所有即将推出电影和剧集幻灯片。

paragraphs.en: Marvel Studios' SDCC presentation is over. We got a lot of news, including Ryan Gosling as Ghost Rider, Deadpool in Avengers: Doomsday, and a release date for Black Panther 3, alongside confirmation of the new actor who plays the superhero. Thanks for sticking with IGN for all the latest from SDCC!
paragraphs.cn: 漫威影业的SDCC发布会结束了。我们获得了大量消息，包括瑞恩·高斯林饰演恶灵骑士、死侍加入《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》、以及《黑豹3》的上映日期和新任黑豹演员的确认。感谢你与IGN一同关注SDCC的最新动态！

paragraphs.en: That’s a wrap - “see you on Doomsday,” Kevin Feige says. #sdcc pic.twitter.com/yEPvq32TGR
paragraphs.cn: 发布会到此结束——凯文·费奇说：「毁灭之日见。」#sdcc pic.twitter.com/yEPvq32TGR

paragraphs.en: Ryan Coogler is on stage to announce Black Panther 3, which is due out December 15, 2028. Letitia and Winston are back on stage. Coogler says the son of the great character Chadwick Boseman played comes of age on Black Panther 3. The new Black Panther is David Jonsson, of Alien: Romulus and The Long Walk fame! Jonsson is overwhelmed by cheers.
paragraphs.cn: 瑞恩·库格勒登台宣布《黑豹3》将于2028年12月15日上映。Letitia和Winston也回到台上。库格勒表示，查德维克·博斯曼所饰演伟大角色的儿子会在《黑豹3》中成长成人。新任黑豹由因《异形：罗穆卢斯》和《死亡竞走》知名的David Jonsson饰演！Jonsson受到全场热烈欢呼。

paragraphs.en: David Johnsson is our new Black Panther!!! #sdcc pic.twitter.com/7CgpCRMFwf
paragraphs.cn: David Johnsson是我们的新任黑豹！！！#sdcc pic.twitter.com/7CgpCRMFwf

paragraphs.en: Ryan Coogler comes out to talk about Black Panther III, announced for December 15, 2028! #SDCC pic.twitter.com/HLpRpK6euV
paragraphs.cn: 瑞恩·库格勒出场谈论《黑豹3》，该片定于2028年12月15日上映！#SDCC pic.twitter.com/HLpRpK6euV

paragraphs.en: The Russo Brothers introduce exclusive Avengers: Doomsday footage. We see Doom on the throne. Sue Storm says he used to be kind, he used to be caring, but everything he loved was taken from him. We see intense shots of Thor, Shang-Chi, Shuri, and Gambit.
paragraphs.cn: 罗素兄弟介绍了《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》的独家片段。我们看到毁灭博士坐在王座上。苏·斯托姆说，他过去曾经善良、体贴，但他所爱的一切都被夺走了。画面还展示了雷神、尚气、舒莉和牌皇的激烈镜头。

paragraphs.en: Doom raises his hand and an army of dormant Sentinels rises from the ground. They're the most comic accurate we’ve seen in a movie.
paragraphs.cn: 毁灭博士抬起手，一支休眠哨兵组成的军队从地下升起。它们是我们在电影中见过最贴近漫画形象的版本。

paragraphs.en: Kevin Feige thanks everyone like the presentation is ending… but is it really? No… the lights haven’t gone up. All the actors leave the stage. It might really be over? But wait…
paragraphs.cn: 凯文·费奇像是发布会即将结束般向所有人致谢……但真的是这样吗？不，灯光还没有亮起。所有演员离开舞台。难道真的结束了？等等……

paragraphs.en: NO. Feige walks back on stage. “There is one more thing..."
paragraphs.cn: 不。费奇重新走回舞台。「还有一件事……」

paragraphs.en: See ya in December, Doomsday cast 👋 #SDCC pic.twitter.com/PeYGj5FOMX
paragraphs.cn: 12月见，《毁灭之日》演员阵容👋 #SDCC pic.twitter.com/PeYGj5FOMX

paragraphs.en: Deadpool is confirmed for Avengers: Doomsday! Ryan Reynolds is in a grey Deadpool costume. Ryan (in mask), says: "Longtime listener, first time caller. I'm a huge fan. I’m not wearing a Doom mask over this mask because I don’t want to ruin the lines of my Canadian tuxedo."
paragraphs.cn: 死侍确认将登场《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》！瑞恩·雷诺兹身穿灰色死侍服。戴着面具的瑞恩说：「老听众，头一次打电话。我是超级粉丝。我没有在这张面具外再戴毁灭博士面具，因为我不想破坏我这身加拿大礼服的线条。」

paragraphs.en: Where is Thor and why was he crying? It's a question we've all had since Deadpool & Wolverine came out. Ant-Man actor Paul Rudd suggests, “he’s a Wrexham fan.”
paragraphs.cn: 雷神在哪里？他为什么会哭？自《死侍与金刚狼》上映后，这就是所有人都想问的问题。《蚁人》演员保罗·路德猜测：「他是雷克瑟姆球迷。」

paragraphs.en: Deadpool asks when Doomsday starts filming. “It’s in the can, bro!” #SDCC pic.twitter.com/FgrbGFBBvZ
paragraphs.cn: 死侍问《毁灭之日》何时开拍。「已经拍完了，兄弟！」#SDCC pic.twitter.com/FgrbGFBBvZ

paragraphs.en: That's the question Kevin Feige asks on-stage. The Russos ask the audience to answer, and there are plenty of yesses. Feige asks Pedro Pascal and RDJ: “Will Reed and Doom have a history together in Doomsday?” They joke, “Besties!”
paragraphs.cn: 这正是凯文·费奇在台上提出的问题。罗素兄弟请观众回答，现场响起了大量肯定声。费奇问佩德罗·帕斯卡和小罗伯特·唐尼：「Reed和毁灭博士会在《毁灭之日》中有共同历史吗？」两人开玩笑回答：「最佳损友！」

paragraphs.en: Avengers directors, the Russo Brothers, arrive on-stage. At the back of Hall H is Rebecca Romijn, Lewis Pullman, James Marsden, Hannah John-Kamen, David Harbour, Kelsey Grammer, Winston Duke, Simu Liu, Tenoch Huerta, Danny Ramirez, Anthony Mackie, Paul Rudd, and maybe more. Back on the front stage is Pedro Pascal, Hayley Atwell (confirming she’s in it), and Chris Evans.
paragraphs.cn: 《复仇者联盟》导演罗素兄弟登台。H厅后方站着Rebecca Romijn、Lewis Pullman、James Marsden、Hannah John-Kamen、David Harbour、Kelsey Grammer、Winston Duke、刘思慕、Tenoch Huerta、Danny Ramirez、Anthony Mackie、保罗·路德，以及可能还有更多人。前方舞台上则有佩德罗·帕斯卡、Hayley Atwell（确认她会出演）和克里斯·埃文斯。

paragraphs.en: Robert Downey Jr. arrives on the front stage. "God bless us all! I gotta tell you, it isn’t easy being green," he says. "I had a lot of help. I had this whole family around me to finally be an arch nemesis. Decisions will have to be made… you have to decide if you’re on the side of the good guys or (IN DOOM VOICE) you may consider the alternative of joining the family of Doom."
paragraphs.cn: 小罗伯特·唐尼走到前方舞台。他说：「上帝保佑我们所有人！我得告诉你们，当个绿色角色并不容易。我得到了很多帮助，身边有整个大家庭，才终于能成为一个大反派。你们将不得不做出选择……你们得决定是站在好人一边，还是——（用毁灭博士的声音）——考虑另一种选择，加入毁灭家族。」

paragraphs.en: Robert Downey Jr. asks people to wear those Doom masks. Hayley Atwell says we’ll need some help, and all the actors at the back are coming to the front stage. They are all walking through the crowd giving high fives. This is a big moment, like 20 Marvel heroes, split on two sides of Hall H, walking to the stage. Harbour gives RDJ a thumbs down because of course he's a bag guy.
paragraphs.cn: 小罗伯特·唐尼请大家戴上那些毁灭博士面具。Hayley Atwell说他们需要一点帮助，后方的所有演员都要走到前方舞台。他们穿过人群，一路与观众击掌。这是个大场面，大约20位漫威英雄分列H厅两侧走向舞台。Harbour朝RDJ竖起大拇指向下，因为他当然是个坏家伙。

paragraphs.en: The Punisher star Jon Bernthal walks on-stage to talk about Spider-Man: Brand New Day, and to introduce new footage. We see Hulk smash Spider-Man on the floor, only the Punisher to walk up and shoot Hulk over and over. Hulk is pissed, as you'd expect, and Spider-Man throws an exploding web, trapping Hulk. Spider-Man asks the Punisher what he's doing here, and he responds to say "I'm saving your ass." Spider-Man adds: "This is way above your paygrade!" Spider-Man webs the Punisher and drags him behind him, underneath Hulk. An explosive is thrown at Hulk, who catches it and says, "Really?" in Mark Ruffalo's voice, as if he's a hybrid Smart / Savage Hulk. He’s roaring and furious but also can speak normally.
paragraphs.cn: 《惩罚者》主演Jon Bernthal登台谈论《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》，并介绍了新片段。我们看到浩克把蜘蛛侠砸到地上，惩罚者随即走上前不断向浩克开枪。正如预料，浩克怒不可遏，蜘蛛侠抛出会爆炸的蛛网困住他。蜘蛛侠问惩罚者在这里做什么，对方回答：「我在救你的命。」蜘蛛侠补充：「这可远超你的薪资级别！」蜘蛛侠用蛛丝缠住惩罚者，把他拖到自己身后、躲在浩克下方。有人向浩克扔出爆炸物，浩克接住后以马克·鲁法洛的声音说：「认真的？」他像是智能浩克与野蛮浩克的混合体，咆哮、愤怒，却也能正常说话。

paragraphs.en: Spider-Man and the Punisher make a plan where Spider-Man will get something while the Punisher distracts. “You’re gonna fight the Hulk?" Spider-Man asks. "I guess so," the Punisher responds. And that's the end of the footage!
paragraphs.cn: 蜘蛛侠和惩罚者制定了一个计划：蜘蛛侠去拿某样东西，惩罚者负责分散注意力。「你要去对付浩克？」蜘蛛侠问。「看来是这样。」惩罚者回答。片段到此结束！

paragraphs.en: As rumored, Marvel Studios has confirmed a Ghost Rider movie, and it's Ryan Gosling in the title role! Ryan Gosling is on-stage: "Wow, is this really happening? Okay… uh… as you know, this is a character I’ve wanted to play for a very long time." The director is Deadpool & Wolverine director Shawn Levy, who arrives on-stage. Levy is of course the director of Star Wars: Starfighter, which stars Gosling. Ghost Rider is due out at some point in 2028. The logo is in the image below.
paragraphs.cn: 正如传闻所说，漫威影业确认将推出《恶灵骑士》电影，由瑞恩·高斯林担任主角！瑞恩·高斯林在台上说：「哇，这真的发生了吗？好吧……呃……你们知道，这是我很久以来一直想演的角色。」导演是登台亮相的《死侍与金刚狼》导演肖恩·利维；利维当然也是由高斯林主演的《星球大战：星际战机》导演。《恶灵骑士》计划于2028年的某个时间上映，下图展示了其标志。

paragraphs.en: The Ghost Rider logo has been revealed at #SDCC , alongside the reveal that Shawn Levy is directing, and it's coming in 2028 pic.twitter.com/L73OqdX51P
paragraphs.cn: 《恶灵骑士》标志已在#SDCC公布，同时确认由肖恩·利维执导，并将于2028年推出。pic.twitter.com/L73OqdX51P

paragraphs.en: Marvel Studios chief Kevin Feige is on the stage. His hat has an image of Doctor Doom on it. Feige talks about Marvel's history in Hall H: the first Avengers cast reveal, Loki actor Tom Hiddleston in costume, and the Robert Downey Jr. reveal as Doctor Doom from two years ago. He says it all comes back to the comics. "Without the comics, no MCU, no movies, no TV shows, no animation, nothin," Feige says.
paragraphs.cn: 漫威影业掌门人凯文·费奇站在台上，帽子上印着毁灭博士的图案。费奇谈到漫威在H厅的历史：首批《复仇者联盟》演员亮相、身着戏服的洛基演员汤姆·希德勒斯顿，以及两年前公布小罗伯特·唐尼饰演毁灭博士。他说这一切都要回到漫画本身。「没有漫画，就没有MCU、没有电影、没有电视剧、没有动画，什么都没有。」费奇说。

paragraphs.en: Feige asks if anyone is watching X-Men '97, which gets plenty of cheers. He also mentions Disney Plus show, Vision Quest, which is coming out in October as the third part of the WandaVision trilogy. “We’re very excited for that," he says.
paragraphs.cn: 费奇问现场有没有人在看《X战警97》，得到大量欢呼。他还提到Disney Plus剧集《幻视探索》，它将于10月推出，作为《旺达幻视》三部曲的第三部。「我们对此非常兴奋。」他说。

paragraphs.en: Feige is here to mainly talk about MCU movies though, and mentions Endgame to more cheers. We're shown a trailer for Avengers: Endgame Encore. The trailer we see is all old footage, but the logo is ENDGAME ENCORE (no “Avengers”). Feige then says it will have exclusive footage from Doomsday.
paragraphs.cn: 不过费奇此行主要还是为了谈MCU电影，他提到《终局之战》时再次引发欢呼。现场播放了《复仇者联盟：终局之战 安可》的预告片，预告所用全是旧画面，但标志写作「ENDGAME ENCORE」（没有「Avengers」）。费奇随后表示，其中将收录《毁灭之日》的独家片段。

paragraphs.en: We're about to begin, and we're being told not to record footage. That means NEW footage will be shown here at Hall H! The Marvel Studios logo is displayed, alongside footage from previous Marvel movies, including Black Panther, The Fantastic Four, Shang-Chi, Spider-Man movies, and Deadpool & Wolverine. Huge cheers for Deadpool & Wolverine!
paragraphs.cn: 发布会即将开始，现场被告知不得录制画面。这意味着H厅将播放新片段！漫威影业标志出现，伴随以往漫威电影的画面，包括《黑豹》、《神奇四侠》、尚气、蜘蛛侠电影和《死侍与金刚狼》。《死侍与金刚狼》得到巨大欢呼！

paragraphs.en: Herbie (the original The Fantastic Four: First Steps design) is on-stage, just rolling around on his own. He's laughing and waving hello in Herbie speak. This is good crowd warming up stuff! Herbie said goodbye, waves, and rolls away.
paragraphs.cn: 赫比（初代《神奇四侠：初露锋芒》设计）登上舞台，独自在场上滚来滚去。他用赫比的语言笑着向大家挥手问好，这很适合为观众暖场！赫比随后道别、挥手并滚着离开。

paragraphs.en: Marvel Studios is handing out plastic Doom masks to attendees. The audience is chanting, "Doom! Doom! Doom!" Yes, there's a lot of energy in Hall H right now...
paragraphs.cn: 漫威影业正在向到场观众发放塑料毁灭博士面具。观众齐声高喊：「毁灭！毁灭！毁灭！」没错，H厅此刻气氛非常热烈……

paragraphs.en: doommaxxing #sdcc pic.twitter.com/rX6AoGUp2l
paragraphs.cn: 毁灭博士拉满 #sdcc pic.twitter.com/rX6AoGUp2l

paragraphs.en: The previous panel in Hall H (Entertainment Weekly’s Bold School panel) has just ended 15 minutes late, so we think Marvel Studios will be about 15 minutes late. Yes, we're running late!
paragraphs.cn: H厅上一场活动（《娱乐周刊》的Bold School发布会）刚刚晚了15分钟结束，因此我们认为漫威影业的发布会也会晚约15分钟。没错，我们要延迟了！

paragraphs.en: This is your 30 minute warning. We'll soon be starting our live reporting of the Marvel Studios panel, so be sure to check back here for updates.
paragraphs.cn: 这是提前30分钟提醒。我们很快将开始对漫威影业发布会进行实时报道，请记得回来查看更新。

summary: 漫威影业SDCC发布会确认：瑞恩·高斯林主演《恶灵骑士》、死侍与佩吉·卡特加入《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》、David Jonsson成为新任黑豹，《黑豹3》将于2028年12月15日上映。现场还播放了《毁灭之日》和《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》片段，但未公布《秘密战争》或《X战警》电影详情。
opus_summary: 漫威SDCC交出一串重磅信息：高斯林主演《恶灵骑士》，死侍确认加入《毁灭之日》，《黑豹3》定档2028年。更大的《秘密战争》与《X战警》计划仍未揭晓。
